text: What is the real price of this loan? The interest they showing seems too low, so what other fees I have to pay?
en: What is the real price of this loan? The interest they showing seems too low, so what other fees I have to pay?

text: I received a message about a loan. Can you tell me how much it will cost me totally, including all the charges?
en: I received a message about a loan. Can you tell me how much it will cost me totally, including all the charges?

text: I got this loan offer on my phone, but I don't understand the interest part. Is it the actual cost or are there hidden charges?
en: I got this loan offer on my phone, but I don't understand the interest part. Is it the actual cost or are there hidden charges?

text: The interest rate shown in the offer is confusing. Is that the only thing I pay, or are there more costs?
en: The interest rate shown in the offer is confusing. Is that the only thing I pay, or are there more costs?

text: Mujhe loan ka offer aaya hai phone pe. Interest jo dikha rahe hain, wahi final cost hai ya kuch aur charges bhi hain?
en: I received an offer for a loan on PhonePe. Is the interest rate the same as the final cost or are there other charges?

text: Yaar, is loan ka actual kharcha kitna hoga? Interest ke alawa koi hidden charges toh nahi hai na?
en: Hey, how much is the actual cost of this loan? Is there anything else unusual or unexpected in the interest payment details?

text: Loan offer dekha, but samajh nahi aaya. Interest rate theek hai ya total cost zyada pad jayega?
en: Saw the loan offer, but didn't understand it. Assume the interest rate is suitable or the total cost is significantly high.

text: मुझे लोन का ऑफर आया है। ब्याज जो दिखा रहे हैं, क्या वही असली खर्च है या कुछ और चार्जेस भी हैं?
en: I have received an offer for a loan. Are the interest payments the same as the actual expenses?

text: எனக்கு போனில் லோன் ஆஃபர் வந்தது. வட்டி மட்டும்தான் செலவா? இல்ல வேற ஏதாவது சார்ஜ் இருக்கா?
en: I got a call from the bank regarding a loan offer. Is the interest alone the expense? Is there any other charge?

text: इस लोन में कुल कितना पैसा देना पड़ेगा? ब्याज के अलावा कोई छिपा हुआ चार्ज तो नहीं है?
en: How much total money will have to be paid in this loan? Is there any hidden charge besides the interest?

text: லோன் ஆஃபர் பார்த்தேன். வட்டி தவிர வேற எந்த கட்டணமும் இருக்குமா? மொத்த செலவு சொல்லுங்க.
en: I found a loan offer. Are there any fees other than the interest? Could you please provide the total cost?

text: இந்த லோனின் உண்மையான செலவு என்ன? வட்டி குறைவா காட்டுறாங்க, ஆனா மொத்தமா எவ்வளவு ஆகும்?
en: What is the actual cost of this loan? They are offering a lower interest rate, but on the total amount.

text: If I pay the whole thing now, any extra money I have to give?
en: If I pay the whole thing now, any extra money I have to give?

text: Can I finish my loan before time? Will they take fine or something?
en: Can I finish my loan before time? Will they take fine or something?

text: I want to settle full amount early. Is there any charges for that?
en: I want to settle full amount early. Is there any charges for that?

text: Early closing possible ah? Any penalty I must pay?
en: Early closing possible ah? Any penalty I must pay?

text: Jaldi close karne pe penalty hai ya nahi batao
en: Tell me if there is a penalty for closing early or not.

text: Loan pehle band kar sakte hain? Koi extra paisa lagega kya?
en: Can we pay off the loan first? Is there any extra cost?

text: Agar main pura amount abhi de du to kuch charge katega?
en: If I pay the entire amount now, will there be any charges?

text: क्या मैं लोन समय से पहले बंद कर सकता हूँ? कोई जुर्माना लगेगा?
en: Can I close the loan before the tenure? Will there be any fine?

text: லோனை முன்னாடியே மூடலாமா? அதுக்கு எதுவும் கட்டணம் இருக்கா?
en: Can I close the loan before? Is there a charge for that?

text: पूरा पैसा अभी दे दूं तो कोई अतिरिक्त चार्ज है क्या?
en: If I pay the full amount now, is there any extra charge?

text: I want to cancel the loan I just took. How many days do I have?
en: I want to cancel the loan I just took. How many days do I have?

text: சீக்கிரம் அடைச்சா அபராதம் ஏதும் உண்டா சொல்லுங்க
en: If it is completed quickly, is there any penalty? Tell me

text: What is the time limit for cancelling a loan? I changed my mind.
en: What is the time limit for cancelling a loan? I changed my mind.

text: முழு பணத்தையும் இப்போவே கட்டினா கூடுதல் பணம் கேப்பாங்களா?
en: Will they ask for extra money if the full amount is paid now?

text: Can I still back out? Just signed yesterday.
en: Can I still back out? Just signed yesterday.

text: Is there any cooling period? I just signed the papers.
en: Is there any cooling period? I just signed the papers.

text: Loan cancel karna hai, kitne din ka time hai?
en: You want to cancel your loan, how many days do you have?

text: Maine kal hi sign kiya hai, abhi cancel kar sakta hoon?
en: I just signed, can I cancel now?

text: Loan wapas nahi chahiye, kitne din tak cancel ho sakta hai?
en: The loan is non-refundable, so please specify the period of the cancellation.

text: मैंने अभी लोन साइन किया है, क्या मैं इसे रद्द कर सकता हूँ? कितने दिन हैं?
en: I have just signed a loan, can I cancel it? How many days are there?

text: நான் இப்போதுதான் கடன் ஒப்பந்தம் செய்தேன், ரத்து செய்ய முடியுமா? எத்தனை நாட்கள் உள்ளன?
en: I have just signed a loan agreement, can I cancel it? How many days are there?

text: लोन रद्द करने का समय क्या है? मुझे नहीं चाहिए अब।
en: What is the loan cancellation time? I'm not looking for one now.

text: கடனை ரத்து செய்ய எவ்வளவு நாள் ஆகும்? எனக்கு வேண்டாம்.
en: How long does it take to cancel a loan? I don't want to.

text: I have some extra money this month, should I close my loan or put it in something?
en: I have some extra money this month, should I close my loan or put it in something?

text: Which is better, paying the EMI before time or doing SIP?
en: Which is better, paying the EMI before time or doing SIP?

text: நேற்று கையெழுத்திட்டேன், இன்னும் ரத்து செய்யலாமா? எத்தனை நாள் time இருக்கு?
en: I signed it yesterday, can I cancel it now? How many days are you available?

text: My friend saying invest, but loan interest is also biting. What to do?
en: My friend saying invest, but loan interest is also biting. What to do?

text: Sir, thoda paisa bacha hai, loan pehle bharna chahiye ya invest karna?
en: Sir, thoda paisa bacha hai, loan pehle bharna chahiye ya invest karna?

text: I got bonus, so pay the bank or buy gold?
en: I got bonus, so pay the bank or buy gold?

text: Loan ka byaaj zyada lag raha, ya SIP karke zyada milega?
en: Is the loan interest rate higher, or is it possible that I get more through SIP?

text: EMI jaldi khatam karu ya mutual fund me daalu?
en: Shall I pay the EMI now or should I transfer it to the mutual fund?

text: कुछ पैसे बचे हैं, कर्ज़ चुका दूँ या निवेश करूँ?
en: Have some money left over to pay off debt or invest?

text: கொஞ்சம் பணம் மிச்சம் இருக்கு, கடனை அடைக்கலாமா இல்ல முதலீடு செய்யலாமா?
en: Have some money left over to pay off debt or invest?

text: बैंक का ब्याज़ भारी पड़ रहा है, पहले उसे उतारूँ या कहीं लगा दूँ?
en: The bank is costing a lot, should I pay it off now or put it somewhere?

text: வட்டி அதிகமா இருக்கு, முன்கூட்டியே கட்டிடலாமா அல்லது வேற எதுலயாவது போடலாமா?
en: The interest is high, should I pay the advance or can you put it in something else?

text: போனஸ் பணம் வந்திருக்கு, வங்கிக் கடனை முடிக்கலாமா அல்லது தங்கம் வாங்கலாமா?
en: With the bonus, can I pay off the bank loan or buy gold?

text: How much insurance do I need for my family? My wife and two kids also.
en: How much insurance do I need for my family? My wife and two kids also.

text: I have 5 lakh cover, is it enough or I should take more?
en: I have 5 lakh cover, is it enough or I should take more?

text: My company gave health insurance, but my parents not covered in that. What to do?
en: My company gave health insurance, but my parents not covered in that. What to do?

text: Sir my age 34, salary 40 thousand, how much policy I should take for safety?
en: Sir my age 34, salary 40 thousand, how much policy I should take for safety?

text: Mere paas sirf company ka insurance hai, family ke liye alag lena padega kya?
en: I only have company insurance, do I need to get a separate one for my family?

text: Bhai kitna cover sahi rahega? Ghar mein 4 log hai aur main akela kamata hoon.
en: How much will the cover be, brother? There are 4 people in the house and I am the sole breadwinner.

text: मेरे परिवार के लिए कितना बीमा लेना चाहिए?
en: How much insurance should I get for my family?

text: Health insurance liya tha 2 saal pehle, abhi bhi kaafi hai ya badhana chahiye?
en: Did you renew your health insurance policy two years ago? 2

text: என் குடும்பத்துக்கு எவ்வளவு காப்பீடு எடுக்கணும்?
en: How much coverage do I need for my family?

text: बच्चों के लिए अलग पॉलिसी लेनी पड़ेगी या एक में हो जाएगा?
en: Do we have to get a separate policy for children or will it be included?

text: நான் எடுத்திருக்கிற கவரேஜ் போதுமா இல்லை அதிகமா வேணுமா?
en: Is the coverage I have taken enough or do I need more?

text: கம்பெனி இன்சூரன்ஸ் இருக்கு, ஆனா அம்மா அப்பாவுக்கு சேராது, என்ன செய்யலாம்?
en: I have company insurance but it doesn't cover parents, what should I do?

text: I am confuse about family floater plan, how it works?
en: I am confuse about family floater plan, how it works?

text: What is the difference between term and health insurance?
en: What is the difference between term and health insurance?

text: Top-up insurance means what? Is it extra coverage?
en: Top-up insurance means what? Is it extra coverage?

text: Can you explain term plan vs health plan in simple words?
en: Can you explain term plan vs health plan in simple words?

text: Term plan aur health plan mein kya fark hai?
en: What is the difference between a term plan and a health plan?

text: Top-up plan ka matlab samjhao na, confuse ho raha hoon.
en: I'm not sure I understand what you mean by 'top-up plan'.

text: Family floater kya hota hai, sabko cover karta hai?
en: What about a family floater, does that cover everyone?

text: फैमिली फ्लोटर प्लान कैसे काम करता है?
en: How does a family floater plan work?

text: टर्म और हेल्थ इंश्योरेंस में क्या अंतर है?
en: What is the difference between term and health insurance?

text: டேர்ம் மற்றும் ஹெல்த் இன்சூரன்ஸ் வித்தியாசம் என்ன?
en: What is the difference between term and health insurance?

text: I took the policy last week only, I don't want it now. Can I get my money back?
en: I took the policy last week only, I don't want it now. Can I get my money back?

text: ஃபேமிலி ஃப்ளோட்டர் பிளான் என்றால் என்ன?
en: What is a family floater plan?

text: டாப்-அப் இன்சூரன்ஸ் பற்றி கொஞ்சம் விளக்குங்கள்.
en: Can you tell me more about the top-up insurance?

text: My wife is saying why you bought this, so can we return this policy? Money will come back or not?
en: My wife is saying why you bought this, so can we return this policy? Money will come back or not?

text: Hello, I am not interested in this insurance, please tell me how to give it back and get full amount.
en: Hello, I am not interested in this insurance, please tell me how to give it back and get full amount.

text: Just few days back I paid, is there any option to cancel and take refund?
en: Just few days back I paid, is there any option to cancel and take refund?

text: Sirji kal hi policy liya hai, abhi mann badal gaya. Paisa wapas milega kya?
en: Sir, the policy was taken just yesterday, and the policy has been renewed recently. Will you get the money back?

text: Maine recently hi ye insurance liya tha, cancel karna hai to kitna paisa kat jayega?
en: Since I just took out this insurance recently, how much should I expect to pay if I decide to cancel it?

text: Bhaiya policy return karne ka koi time hota hai? Do din pehle hi liya hai, refund chahiye.
en: Brother, is there a specific time frame for returning the policy? Since it's been 2 days, you can proceed with the refund.

text: मैंने अभी हाल में ही पॉलिसी ली है, अब नहीं चाहिए। पैसे वापस मिल सकते हैं क्या?
en: I have taken the policy recently, I don't want to anymore. Can the money be refunded?

text: நான் இந்த இன்சூரன்ஸ் சில நாள் முன்னாடி தான் எடுத்தேன், இப்போ வேண்டாம். பணம் திரும்ப கிடைக்குமா?
en: I purchased this insurance policy a few days ago, and I no longer require it. Will the money be refunded?

text: पॉलिसी लेने का मन नहीं है अब, कुछ दिन पहले ही खरीदी थी, रिफंड हो जाएगा?
en: I don't want to buy the policy now, I purchased it a few days ago, will there be a refund?

text: பாலிசியை திருப்பி கொடுத்துடலாமா? வாங்கின பணம் முழுசா வரும் இல்லையா?
en: Can I return the policy? Will I get the money I paid in full?

text: Why did I get less money than the hospital bill?
en: Why did I get less money than the hospital bill?

text: சார், நான் இப்போ தான் போன வாரம் காப்பீடு எடுத்தேன், வேண்டாம்னு இருக்கு. கேன்சல் பண்ணா பணம் மறுபடியும் வருமா?
en: Sir, I have taken insurance last week, I don't want to pay it. Will the money be refunded if cancelled?

text: I got only 40,000 but bill was 60,000. Why cut?
en: I got only 40,000 but bill was 60,000. Why cut?

text: My insurance gave less. Hospital charged more. Please explain.
en: My insurance gave less. Hospital charged more. Please explain.

text: Claim settled but amount is not matching. What is reason?
en: Claim settled but amount is not matching. What is reason?

text: Hospital bill zyada tha, insurance ne kam diya. Kya scene hai?
en: The hospital bill was higher, but the insurance gave less. What's the scene?

text: Mere claim mein deduction kyun hua? Poora paisa nahi aaya.
en: Why was I denied a deduction on my claim? The money did not come in full.

text: Claim toh ho gaya but paisa kam mila, kyun?
en: Claim successful, but I'm facing a payment issue.

text: मुझे पूरा पैसा क्यों नहीं मिला? बिल ज्यादा था।
en: Why didn't I receive the full amount? The bill was high.

text: क्लेम सेटल हो गया लेकिन कम पैसे आए, कारण क्या है?
en: The claim was settled, but less money came, what is the reason?

text: முழு பணம் ஏன் வரவில்லை? மருத்துவமனை பில் அதிகமாக இருந்தது.
en: Why is the full payment not coming? The hospital bills were huge.

text: My father is in hospital, what all papers I need to give for claim?
en: My father is in hospital, what all papers I need to give for claim?

text: கிளைம் செட்டிலானது ஆனா பணம் கம்மியா வந்திருக்கு, ஏன்?
en: The claim was settled but the amount received is less, why?

text: How to start the insurance claim? Hospital people asking something.
en: How to start the insurance claim? Hospital people asking something.

text: நான் எதிர்பார்த்ததை விட குறைவான தொகை வந்துள்ளது, காரணம் என்ன?
en: The amount is less than what I expected, can you tell me why?

text: I have policy but don't know procedure. Please tell me documents required.
en: I have policy but don't know procedure. Please tell me documents required.

text: Claim file karne ke liye kya kya chahiye? Doctor ka letter? Bill?
en: What is required to file a claim? The doctor's letter? Bill?

text: Bhaiya hospital mein admit hai, claim kaise karein? Kya documents chahiye?
en: My brother is admitted in the hospital, how do I file the claim? What documents are required?

text: Insurance claim ke liye kya form bharna hai? Aur kahan dena hai?
en: For filing an insurance claim, what form is used? And where to give it?

text: Papa ko discharge karna hai, claim ke liye kya kya laana hoga?
en: What should I bring to help my dad with his claim?

text: मेरे पति अस्पताल में भर्ती हैं, बीमा का दावा कैसे करें? कौन कौन से कागज चाहिए?
en: My husband is hospitalized, how do I file an insurance claim? Which documents are required?

text: க்ளைம் பார்க்க என்ன பாரம் பில்லு எல்லாம் கொடுக்கணும்? கொஞ்சம் சொல்லுங்க.
en: What documents and bills do I need to submit for claim processing? Please tell me a little.

text: என் அம்மா மருத்துவமனையில் இருக்கிறார், காப்பீட்டு க்ளைம் எப்படி செய்வது? என்ன ஆவணங்கள் வேண்டும்?
en: My mother is in the hospital, how do I file an insurance claim? What documents are needed?

text: I am not at all happy with the settlement amount, it is too less, nobody explained me why
en: I am not at all happy with the settlement amount, it is too less, nobody explained me why

text: क्लेम के लिए क्या फॉर्म भरना होता है? और कहाँ जमा करना है?
en: What is the form that needs to be filled for the claim? And where do I have to deposit it?

text: Your agent is not picking my call since two weeks, I want to talk to senior person
en: Your agent is not picking my call since two weeks, I want to talk to senior person

text: அப்பா டிஸ்சார்ஜ் ஆகிறார், இன்சூரன்ஸ் க்ளைம் தொடங்க என்ன செய்யணும்?
en: My father is getting discharged, what should I do to initiate the insurance claim?

text: Claim got rejected without any proper reason, this is very unfair, please do something
en: Claim got rejected without any proper reason, this is very unfair, please do something

text: I have submitted all documents still you people are asking same thing again and again
en: I have submitted all documents still you people are asking same thing again and again

text: Claim ka paisa abhi tak nahi aaya, kitna din aur wait karna hai batao
en: Claim payment is not received yet, how many days and how much to wait, please tell.

text: Mujhe complaint file karna hai, jo bhi chaiye batao, par yeh claim dobara check karo
en: I want to file a complaint, tell me whatever you want, but check this claim again.

text: Aapke surveyor ne jo report diya hai wo galat hai, meri gaadi ka nuksaan zyada tha
en: The report given by your surveyor is wrong, my car suffered more damage.

text: मेरा क्लेम बिना वजह रिजेक्ट कर दिया, मुझे इसका लिखित में कारण चाहिए
en: My claim was denied without reason, I want the written reason for this

text: என் கிளைம் இன்னும் தீர்வு ஆகல, யாரும் எனக்கு பதில் சொல்லல
en: My claim is still pending and I haven't heard from anyone

text: तीन बार फोन किया, कोई जवाब नहीं आ रहा, बहुत खराब सर्विस है आपकी
en: I called three times, but there is no response. Your service is very bad

text: நீங்க கொடுத்த தொகை ரொம்ப கம்மி, நான் இதை ஏத்துக்க மாட்டேன், மேல அதிகாரிக்கு பேசணும்
en: "You have paid an exorbitant sum, I cannot accept it and I have to deal with my superior!"

text: I got a SMS saying my loan is approved but they want 5000 rupees fee first. Is this real or fake?
en: I got a SMS saying my loan is approved but they want 5000 rupees fee first. Is this real or fake?

text: Someone called and said my KYC is expiring today, they are asking for OTP. Should I give?
en: Someone called and said my KYC is expiring today, they are asking for OTP. Should I give?

text: I won a lottery of 10 lakhs, they are asking for my bank details to transfer. Is it genuine?
en: I won a lottery of 10 lakhs, they are asking for my bank details to transfer. Is it genuine?

text: ஆவணங்கள் எல்லாம் கொடுத்தாச்சு, திரும்ப திரும்ப கேட்கிறீங்களே, இது நியாயமா
en: "You've given us all the papers, now you don't want to ask for them again?"

text: There is a collect request on my UPI app from some unknown person. What to do?
en: There is a collect request on my UPI app from some unknown person. What to do?

text: Mujhe ek call aaya tha ki mera KYC expire ho gaya hai, aur woh OTP maang rahe hain. Kya main de doon?
en: I received a call from the bank stating that my KYC is expired and they are asking for an OTP. Would you like me to provide them?

text: Bhaiya, ek message aaya hai loan approved ka, pehle 3000 rupees fees maang rahe hain. Yeh sahi hai kya?
en: Brother, I just received a text message that the loan approval is complete, but the initial fees are Rs. 3000. Is this correct?

text: Kisi ne call karke kaha ki maine prize jeeta hai, aur account number maang rahe hain. Kya karna chahiye?
en: Someone calls claiming to be from the insurance company, asking for your account number to process a claim. What should be done?

text: मेरे पास एक मैसेज आया है कि लोन अप्रूव हो गया है, पहले फीस जमा करनी है। क्या यह असली है?
en: I have a message that the loan has been approved, but I need to pay the fees first. Is it real?

text: मुझे एक कॉल आया कि मेरा केवाईसी एक्सपायर हो रहा है, ओटीपी मांग रहे हैं। क्या यह सही है?
en: I received a call saying that my KYC is expiring, and they are asking for an OTP. Is that correct?

text: எனக்கு ஒரு கால் வந்தது, என் கேஒய்சி காலாவதி ஆகிறதாம், ஓடிபி கேட்கிறார்கள். இது உண்மையா?
en: I received a call saying my KYC is expiring and they are asking for the OTP. Is it true?

text: லோன் அப்ரூவ் ஆகிவிட்டதாம், முதல்ல பீஸ் கட்டணும்னு மெசேஜ் வந்தது. இது நம்பலாமா?
en: I've received the message that your loan has been approved, you need to pay the first installment. Can we trust this?

text: I need some money for my shop stock, how I can get it?
en: I need some money for my shop stock, how I can get it?

text: My business is small only, can I take working capital? What is the procedure?
en: My business is small only, can I take working capital? What is the procedure?

text: யாரோ பரிசு வென்றதாக சொல்லி, வங்கி விவரங்கள் கேட்கிறார்கள். இது மோசடியா?
en: Someone is asking for bank details claiming that they have won a prize. Is it cheating?

text: Want to buy more goods for store but no cash, any help for that?
en: Want to buy more goods for store but no cash, any help for that?

text: Shop ke liye maal lena hai, small loan possible hai kya?
en: Got to buy goods for the shop, is a small loan possible?

text: Bhaiya shop ke liye thoda paisa chahiye, stock kharidna hai
en: Brother, I need some money for the shop, I need to buy stock.

text: Mujhe apne dukaan ke liye loan chahiye, kaise milega batao na
en: I need a loan for my shop, how will I get it, please tell me

text: Chhota business hai, maal lene ke liye kuch paisa mil sakta hai?
en: We have a small business, can we get some money for the goods?

text: दुकान के लिए माल खरीदना है, पैसे की जरूरत है। क्या कोई लोन मिल सकता है?
en: I need to buy groceries for the shop, I need money. Can I get a loan?

text: मेरा छोटा सा काम है, स्टॉक के लिए थोड़ा पैसा चाहिए।
en: I have a small task, I need some money for stock.

text: கடைக்கு சரக்கு வாங்க பணம் வேணும், லோன் கிடைக்குமா?
en: I need money to buy groceries for the shop, will I get a loan?

text: என் கடைக்கு கொஞ்சம் மூலதனம் தேவை, எப்படி வாங்கலாம்?
en: I need some capital for my shop, how can I get it?

text: சின்ன வியாபாரம், பொருள் வாங்க கடன் உதவி கிடைக்குமா சொல்லுங்க
en: Small business, will I get loan assistance to buy goods

text: Hello? Is this a recording? I need to talk to somebody real.
en: Hello? Is this a recording? I need to talk to somebody real.

text: Can you connect me to your agent? This machine is not understanding what I am saying.
en: Can you connect me to your agent? This machine is not understanding what I am saying.

text: I don't want to talk to computer only, give me a human person please.
en: I don't want to talk to computer only, give me a human person please.

text: Hello hello, are you there? Please put a man on the line.
en: Hello hello, are you there? Please put a man on the line.

text: Bhaiya machine se baat nahi karni, koi aadmi se connect karo na.
en: Don't talk to the machine, please connect with a human agent.

text: Sun rahe ho? Mujhe kisi insaan se baat karni hai, recording se nahi.
en: Are you listening? I need to talk to a human being, not a recording.

text: Ye automated cheez band karo, customer care wale bande se baat karni hai.
en: I understand your frustration, but for now, I recommend contacting customer care.

text: मुझे किसी इंसान से बात करनी है, मशीन से नहीं।
en: I want to talk to a person, not a machine.

text: நான் மனிதரிடம் பேசணும், இந்த மெஷின்கிட்ட இல்ல.
en: I need to talk to a human, not a machine.

text: हेलो, कोई असली आदमी है वहाँ? मुझे एजेंट से जोड़ो।
en: Hello, are there any real men there? Connect me with the agent.

text: ஹலோ, யாராவது இருக்கீங்களா? ஒரு நேரடி ஆளைக் கூப்பிடுங்க.
en: Hello, is there anyone there? Please call the human.

text: I don't want my salary details used anymore, take it out.
en: I don't want my salary details used anymore, take it out.

text: இந்த ரெக்கார்டிங் வேண்டாம், உங்க ஆபீஸ்ல ஆள் கிடைப்பாரா?
en: We don't need this recording, could you please find someone in your office?

text: Please stop using my income information for anything, I changed my mind.
en: Please stop using my income information for anything, I changed my mind.

text: Why you are keeping my money details? Remove it now.
en: Why you are keeping my money details? Remove it now.

text: I gave my earnings data before, but now don't use it, okay?
en: I gave my earnings data before, but now don't use it, okay?

text: Meri income ki detail mat use karo ab, hata do.
en: Don't use my income details, remove it now.

text: Jo salary bataya tha, usko permission wapas le raha hoon.
en: I am taking back the permission for the salary that was mentioned.

text: मेरी आय की जानकारी अब इस्तेमाल मत करो, हटा दो।
en: Please remove my income information now.

text: Paisa ka info jo diya tha, ab mat use karna.
en: Don't use the money info I gave you.

text: என் வருமான விவரத்தை இனி பயன்படுத்தாதீங்க, நிறுத்திடுங்க.
en: Stop using my income information.

text: முன்பு சொன்ன சம்பள தகவலை இப்போ வேண்டாம், அனுமதியை திரும்ப பெறுகிறேன்.
en: I'd like to apologize again for the inconvenience caused by the previous salary information and I'll endeavor to rectify the situation.

text: पहले जो कमाई बताई थी, उसकी अनुमति वापस लेता हूँ।
en: I hereby retract my previous statement regarding earnings.

text: Okay okay, thank you very much, bye bye
en: Okay okay, thank you very much, bye bye

text: That's all no, I will call later, thank you
en: That's all no, I will call later, thank you

text: No more doubts, thanks for the help, bye
en: No more doubts, thanks for the help, bye

text: என் பண விஷயத்தை வேற எதுக்கும் உபயோகிக்க வேணாம்.
en: I don't want to use my money for anything else.

text: Fine fine, ok, cut the phone
en: Fine fine, ok, cut the phone

text: Bas itna hi, thank you, phone rakhta hoon
en: That's all, thank you, I'll hang up the phone.

text: Theek hai bhai, rakhta hoon, kal baat karte
en: Okay brother, I'll keep it, we'll talk tomorrow

text: Chalo theek hai, phir bolta hoon, bye
en: Alright, I'll tell you later, bye.

text: अच्छा ठीक है, धन्यवाद, फोन रखता हूँ
en: Okay, fine, thank you, I'll hang up

text: சரி சரி, நன்றி, போனை வைக்கிறேன்
en: Okay okay, thank you, I'll hang up

text: बस इतना ही, बहुत बहुत धन्यवाद, नमस्ते
en: That's all, thank you very much, greetings

text: அவ்வளவுதான், ரொம்ப நன்றி, அப்புறம் பேசலாம்
en: Thank you very much, we will talk later

text: சரிங்க, நன்றி, வச்சுடறேன்
en: Thank you, I'll keep it

text: What is the cricket score right now?
en: What is the cricket score right now?

text: Which share I should buy for good profit?
en: Which share I should buy for good profit?

text: How much balance is there in my account?
en: How much balance is there in my account?

text: Is it going to rain today in Mumbai?
en: Is it going to rain today in Mumbai?

text: Aaj ka mausam kaisa hai? Baarish hogi?
en: How's the weather today? Will it rain?

text: Mera phone ka recharge karna hai, 199 ka plan hai kya?
en: I need to recharge my phone, is there a plan of 199?

text: Train ka ticket book karna hai, kya karna padega?
en: I want to book a train ticket, what do I need to do?

text: मेरा अकाउंट बैलेंस बताइए ना।
en: Please provide me with your account balance.

text: இன்று வானிலை எப்படி இருக்கு?
en: How is the weather today?

text: आज का क्रिकेट स्कोर क्या है?
en: What is today's cricket score?

text: ரயில் டிக்கெட் எப்படி புக் பண்றது?
en: How to book a train ticket?

text: என் அக்கவுண்ட் பேலன்ஸ் எவ்வளவு இருக்கு?
en: How much is my account balance?
